name: ČÚZK INSPIRE Administrative Units (RÚIAN)
tileParameters: XMIN,YMIN,XMAX,YMAX; encoded in each gzip filename in that order
methodology: Full original GML responses. Truncated parent responses are ignored; recursive complete tiles are joined and deduplicated by nationalCode. Country and regions derived by union of authoritative current municipal polygons, region membership from ČSÚ structure 1 January 2026. Area computed before simplification in source projected CRS.
